notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.1.19764611
notes.notes:
Patch NotesAdded
Full Tutorial

Out-of-game points "Fish Snacks", used to unlock content early
Fixed
Occasional incorrect display of item details

Bug where drops were lost after explosions from "Cross Bomb" and "X Bomb"

Bug where "X Rock" could be bombed repeatedly

Incorrect display when "Invalid Bill" and "Fake Bill" were active together

Softlock caused by removing all bills

Occasional drops overrides triggered by certain items

Layout issues when daily settlement produced too many icons
Adjusted
Initial stamp cap: 1 → 2

Initial clear reward: 2 choices → 3 choices

Clear rewards now include all stamp types

Reduced appearance rate of "Time Limit"

Reduced appearance rate of "X Rock"

Increased base drop chance after payment

Increased drop chance after bombing cats

Reduced coin cost for "Refresh Cat": 3–5 → 3–4

Reduced appearance rate of "Restock Cat" 

Reduced appearance rate of "Invalid Bill" and "Fake Bill"
Items
Scissors now destroy only 1 stamp instead of all

Lockpick now works on Key Beggars

Lockpick now prioritizes remaining keys

Eternal Bomb chance: 100% → 33%

Endless Bomb chance: 50% → 33%

Rooster Stamp effect changed to spawn 2 random stamps
UI
Reworked start menu

Reworked in-game Esc menu

Reworked several icons

Added range icons in item info

Item selection box now remains visible

Replaced rock textures

Added walking animation (2 frames only)

Added bill and room descriptions

Added active item descriptions
Input
Reworked some inputs, removed long-press actions

Removed delay during continuous movement
Other
Refactored core code

Refactored all base drop logic

Shortened text descriptions

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.1.18873371
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed a bug where Power Bank had no effect.

Fixed a bug where Family Portrait didn't check for white bills.

Additions



Changes

Updated the background image for inactive Challenge Room to make the hint more noticeable.

Added more hints when trying to access a inactive Challenge Room.

Adjusted receipt position when holding a stamp.

Added more key instructions to the Esc menu.

Bombs can now be canceled with E after being picked up.

Bombs now show target positions in four directions when held.

Updated the description of Bear Paw for clarity.

Replaced the icon for the Recovery stat.

Angel/Devil Room chances are now guaranteed to appear daily.

Changed how starting items are displayed for characters.

Updated description for Floor Stamps

Floor Stamps can now be used normally inside rooms.

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 0.1.18817965
notes.notes:
Fixes

Fixed a bug where active items could be used during payment.

Fixed a bug where the active item D2 had no effect under the X2/X3 Curse.

Additions

Added new Angel Room item: "Cat Ball".

Changes

Added animation effect when replacing active items.

Updated the icon for "Restock Cat".

"Refresh Cat" now refunds if its effect does nothing.

Removed "Mimic" from the Angel Room and it no longer requires unlocking.

Added detailed curse descriptions to the Esc menu.
